title: ray-tracing-shapely: a 2D optical analysis and design environment
description: A 2D optical analysis and design environment in Python, built on Shapely for geometry. Ray lineage as a graph, bidirectional tracing, structural path signatures, run persistence and cross-run comparison, nonimaging design (CPC-family concentrators and Miñano-Benítez SMS profile construction), unit-checked radiometry, IEC 60825-1 and IEC 62471 exposure limits, and an agentic tool surface. 35 of the core distribution's source files are a translation of the Ray Optics Simulation JavaScript project; the remaining 111 were written for this project. Every file declares which it is in its own header.
